missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Талант' is the masculine nominative subject in a possession frame. 'Настоящий' agrees in gender, and 'у неё' shows whose talent it is.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Талант' is the accusative direct object of 'заметил'; inanimate masculine accusative equals nominative. 'Его' marks possession.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Таланта' is genitive after 'нет'. 'Музыкального' agrees in the masculine genitive, and 'у него' frames the possession.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Талантом' is instrumental, governed by 'восхищаются', which always takes that case. 'Её' marks whose talent it is.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with prepositional location. 'Талант' is the nominative subject of 'скрыт'. 'В этом мальчике' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Таланту' is dative after 'к', marking the object of the attitude. 'Относиться' is the infinitive in the impersonal clause.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Талантов' is genitive plural after 'много'. 'Юных' agrees, and 'в классе' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Таланты' is the accusative plural object of 'открывает'; here it refers to abilities, so accusative equals nominative. 'Новые' agrees.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Таланта' is genitive after 'без', expressing lack. 'Стать артистом' uses the instrumental predicate 'артистом'.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Талант' is the nominative subject of 'требует'. 'Упорной работы' is the genitive object that 'требует' governs.
